title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
This page reports the live paper record as it stands. Every position in this record is paper, and no real orders are placed anywhere. A single trade, whether it wins or loses, says nothing about a strategy. The record is read from the engines' own state: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.

## Open positions and closed trades

At the snapshot time of 2026-11-13T21:05:17.970Z, htf-rsi-v007 shows 0 positions open on paper, with 4 closed trades so far and an average of null net per trade. trend-daily-v005 shows 0 positions open on paper, with 6 closed trades so far and an average of -13.22% net per trade. trend-daily-v006 shows 0 positions open on paper, with 7 closed trades so far and an average of -13.34% net per trade.

A count of 0 open positions means the engine's own state shows no open paper position at that snapshot. The closed trade counts are cumulative since each engine's live start. The averages are net per trade. The averages are negative for both trend engines, and the htf-rsi-v007 average is null, so no average net figure is reported for that engine.

The record also notes a NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 that has been open since that date. The first live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is -17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. That ATOM result is one closed trade, and one trade says nothing about a strategy.

## Market filter and nearest breakouts

The Bitcoin market filter is off for trend-daily-v005. The Bitcoin market filter is off for trend-daily-v006. The filter state is part of the engine's own record; it is reported here, not interpreted. This note does not say what an off filter means for future entries, and it does not predict entries.

For trend-daily-v005, the closest names to a 20-day breakout are:
- AVAXUSDT is 7.69% below its high.
- TRXUSDT is 10.39% below its high.
- BNBUSDT is 13.54% below its high.

For trend-daily-v006, the closest names to a 20-day breakout are:
- AVAXUSDT is 7.69% below its high.
- TRXUSDT is 10.39% below its high.
- JUPUSDT is 11.47% below its high.

These distances are measurements from the current price to the 20-day high. They describe how far each name is from that breakout level. AVAXUSDT is closest in both lists at 7.69% below its high. TRXUSDT is second in both lists at 10.39% below its high.

## Record scope and how to read it

v005 counts its live record from 1 October 2026. v006 counts its live record from 9 October 2026. The first live signal came after the 10 October 2026 daily close. The live snapshot was read at 2026-11-13T21:05:17.970Z. htf-rsi-v007 is read from the same running record.

In testing, losses were common and the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise. That expectation is a statement about the tested record, not a claim about the live record. The live record is short. One trade says nothing about a strategy. The ATOM result of -17.9% after the 30 bps round trip is one data point in a short record, and the trend engines show 6 and 7 closed trades with negative averages.

The engines' own state is what this record reports. What is open is reported as 0 for each engine at the snapshot. What closed is reported as 4, 6, and 7 trades with the averages shown. What the market filter is doing is reported as off for both trend engines. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record.

## Where the same numbers appear

The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. The record updates continuously, so the snapshot above is a reading at one moment rather than a final result. Paper signals only. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. The snapshot was read at 2026-11-13T21:05:17.970Z, and the live record continues to update after that time.
